cohort: 219 women with uterine fibroids and age-matched controls, singleton pregnancy, delivery at >24 weeks of gestation, no chronic hypertension, gestational diabetes, pre-existing diabetes mellitus, uterine anomalies, or fetal malformations
finding: Women with multiple uterine fibroids have a significantly increased risk of preterm birth and cesarean delivery, while large fibroids are associated with a higher risk of pPROM.
